title: ShopSquire StoreProfile
description: The agnostic-core CONTRACT. Every config/store_profiles/<vertical>.json MUST carry the `required` slots so the vertical-blind core resolves flavour from the profile and never falls back to hardcoded electronics. Vertical-specific slots (entity_*, identity_*, accessory_*, demo_fallback_catalog, spec_extraction_rules, ranking_rules, ...) are permitted via additionalProperties and are validated by the parity test, not here. Validated by tests/test_store_profile_schema.py (dependency-free validator) and tests/test_profile_parity.py.

id.description: Unique vertical id (matches the filename stem).

cv_returns_pack.description: Which CV returns playbook pack this vertical uses.

brand_price_floors_usd.description: Per-brand realistic price floor (USD) for budget-mismatch clarifying questions.

manufacturers.description: 3-axis brand schema: {manufacturer: {lines, aliases}} — single source for brand label patterns.

nqe_use_case_fallback_question.description: Vertical-appropriate low-confidence use-case disambiguation question {text, options:[{id,label}]} — replaces the hardcoded electronics fallback in recommend_nqe_helpers.

external_research_allowlist.description: Domains the safe-internet-search adapter may surface for this vertical.

spec_extraction_rules.description: OPTIONAL (inline-adapter slot): numeric/flag spec parsing rules. fashion/pharmacy carry it; electronics uses the inline adapter in recommend_utils pending byte-equivalent extraction.

ranking_rules.description: OPTIONAL (inline-adapter slot): use-case rank rules. fashion/pharmacy carry it; electronics uses the inline adapter in recommend_ranking pending byte-equivalent extraction.
